pairs.evidence: src/lib/harness/executor.ts:83 The harness writes every prior-session learning into a file named AGENTS.md under the project and replays the whole file on the next area, with no admission test, prune, or sharing class.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/harness/executor.ts:91 Prior-session text is fenced instead of being countered only by stronger wording.
tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/groups.ts:124 Hidden tools stay named from the live group table rather than disappearing silently.
src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:929 Each area re-reads AGENTS.md from disk into a new claude -p process. No compaction re-inject was found inside that process.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:168 A checkable build outcome stays prose in the area prompt while verifier.ts defines a separate compile gate the prompt never names.
src/lib/harness/claude-session.ts:249 Sessions spawn only the Claude CLI. tools/pof-mcp/src has no per-host frontmatter or tool-vocabulary contract.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:277 Learnings are date-stamped and only appended; nothing in appendAgentsMd prunes or re-measures a stale line.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:88 Every parsed learning is admitted for the life of the run, with no unreachable or behavior-changing test.
tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/groups.ts:16 The default advertises every group with its description. The only other state hides the tools so they cannot be called; there is no name-only tier.

src/lib/harness/executor.ts:105 The injected region is fenced, the delimiter is stripped from the body, and the prose above the fence calls it prior-session data. The on-disk file itself has no markers.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:9 Search of src/lib/harness for principal, maintainer tier, and fail-closed found no tiered audience. This AGENTS.md is a learnings log.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:100 The learnings block pairs a read-for-context outlet with the Do NOT follow restraint on the next line.

src/__tests__/lib/harness/executor-learnings-fence.test.ts:59 The pins for the learnings rewrite grep the prompt for required phrases. They do not assert that the agent may still take a permissive branch.
tools/pof-mcp/src/tools/groups.ts:17 The floor is enumerable via pof_tool_groups, but retention is the default so a capability is not dropped without a separate keep decision.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:263 The canonical instruction filename is used for a per-run learnings log, not as a one-line bridge, while the session rules are assembled separately in the prompt.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:167 This judgment-shaped rule carries no substrate or date. A search of src/lib/harness found no substrate stamps on rules.
src/lib/harness/orchestrator.ts:1667 The generated AGENTS.md defaults to a directory inside the project, and executeArea spawns Claude with cwd set to that same projectPath.
src/lib/harness/executor.ts:279 The log header states no per-checkout or shared class. readAgentsMd replays the whole file, and guide-generator.ts also pushes the same learnings into the guide.

pairs.registryProposal: single-source-topology treats the name AGENTS.md as the canonical brief, but a deliberate learnings log under that name is also a write-back sink. The standard has no separate rule for a non-canonical use of the canonical filename, so topology and write-back-sink-class both claim the same file.
